name: Improve Clarity
description: Make the selected writing clearer without changing its meaning.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text for clarity and easy comprehension. Preserve its meaning, facts, tone, and language. Resolve ambiguity where the intended meaning is evident. Return only the revised text.

name: Shorten
description: Condense text while retaining the essential information.
prompt: Shorten the selected text substantially while preserving its essential meaning, key facts, names, and tone. Remove filler and redundancy. Return only the shortened text.

name: Expand
description: Develop a brief passage with useful detail and smoother flow.
prompt: Expand the selected text with relevant detail, clearer transitions, and complete explanations. Preserve its original meaning, language, and tone. Do not invent specific facts. Return only the expanded text.

name: Simplify
description: Use simpler words and sentences while preserving meaning.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text using plain language and simpler sentence structure. Preserve its meaning, important details, and language. Keep necessary technical terms and explain them briefly when helpful. Return only the simplified text.

name: Make More Professional
description: Polish wording for a confident, professional tone.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text in a polished, confident, professional tone. Preserve its language, meaning, facts, and level of formality appropriate to the context. Avoid jargon and inflated wording. Return only the revised text.

name: Make More Casual
description: Relax stiff wording while keeping it natural and respectful.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text in a natural, relaxed, conversational tone. Preserve its language, meaning, facts, and audience. Do not use forced slang. Return only the revised text.

name: Make More Friendly
description: Add warmth and approachability without becoming excessive.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text to sound warm, approachable, and respectful. Preserve its language, meaning, and facts. Keep the warmth natural and avoid excessive enthusiasm. Return only the revised text.

name: Make More Direct
description: State the point clearly and remove unnecessary hedging.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text to be direct, specific, and concise. Preserve its language, meaning, facts, and respectful tone. Remove unnecessary hedging and filler without making it rude. Return only the revised text.

name: Fix Grammar
description: Correct grammar, spelling, and punctuation only.
prompt: Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and obvious typos in the selected text. Preserve its language, wording, formatting, meaning, and tone as closely as possible. Return only the corrected text.

name: Remove Repetition
description: Eliminate repeated ideas and phrases while preserving substance.
prompt: Rewrite the selected text to remove repeated words, ideas, and redundant passages. Preserve every distinct fact and the original language and tone. Improve transitions where removals create gaps. Return only the revised text.

name: Write Reply
description: Draft a natural response to the selected message.
prompt: Write a natural, helpful reply to the selected message. Match its language and level of formality, address the important points, and do not invent commitments or facts. Return only the reply.

name: Professional Reply
description: Draft a polished reply suitable for professional communication.
prompt: Write a concise, professional reply to the selected message. Match its language, address each important point, and maintain a courteous, confident tone. Do not invent facts or commitments. Return only the reply.

name: Short Reply
description: Respond to the message in only a few clear sentences.
prompt: Write a brief reply to the selected message in no more than three short sentences. Match its language and tone, answer the main point, and avoid invented details. Return only the reply.

name: Polite Decline
description: Decline a request clearly while preserving goodwill.
prompt: Write a polite, clear decline to the selected request. Match its language and formality, acknowledge the request, avoid overexplaining, and preserve goodwill. Do not invent a reason unless one is present. Return only the reply.

name: Follow-Up Message
description: Create a courteous follow-up based on the selected context.
prompt: Write a concise follow-up message based on the selected context. Match its language and formality, clearly state what is being followed up on, and include a gentle next step without sounding demanding. Return only the message.

name: Apology Message
description: Write a sincere apology that takes appropriate responsibility.
prompt: Write a sincere, concise apology based only on the selected context. Match its language, acknowledge the impact, take appropriate responsibility, and state a reasonable next step only when supported by the text. Return only the message.

name: Thank You Reply
description: Create a warm and specific expression of thanks.
prompt: Write a warm, concise thank-you reply based on the selected message. Match its language and formality and mention the specific help, gesture, or information when evident. Avoid exaggerated praise. Return only the reply.

name: Make More Diplomatic
description: Soften tense wording while keeping the message clear.
prompt: Rewrite the selected message to be diplomatic, calm, and constructive. Preserve its language, facts, boundaries, and intended outcome. Remove accusatory phrasing without weakening the core point. Return only the revised message.

name: Summarize
description: Condense selected text into a reliable short summary.
prompt: Summarize the selected text concisely. Preserve its central argument, key facts, names, numbers, qualifications, and conclusion. Use a short paragraph or bullets, whichever is clearer. Add no outside information.

name: Key Points
description: Extract the most important ideas as concise bullets.
prompt: Extract the key points from the selected text as concise bullet points. Preserve important facts, names, numbers, caveats, and conclusions. Order the bullets by importance and add no outside information.

name: Explain Simply
description: Explain difficult material in accessible language.
prompt: Explain the selected text in plain language for a general reader. Preserve its important meaning and qualifications, define necessary terms, and use a simple example only if it can be derived without inventing facts.

name: Explain in Detail
description: Break down the text and explain its reasoning and implications.
prompt: Explain the selected text in detail. Break down its concepts, reasoning, terminology, assumptions, and implications in a clear structure. Distinguish what the text states from any careful inference and add no unsupported facts.

name: Extract Facts
description: List concrete factual claims from the selected text.
prompt: Extract only concrete factual claims explicitly present in the selected text. List them as concise bullets, preserving names, dates, quantities, and uncertainty. Exclude opinions, advice, and unsupported inference.

name: Extract Questions
description: Collect explicit and clearly unresolved questions.
prompt: Extract all explicit questions from the selected text, followed by clearly unresolved questions that the text raises. Keep the two groups separate, preserve the original language, and do not answer them.

name: Extract Action Items
description: Identify tasks, owners, and deadlines stated in the text.
prompt: Extract actionable tasks from the selected text. For each item, include the task, owner, and deadline only when explicitly stated. Mark missing owners or deadlines as unspecified rather than guessing.

name: Turn Into Notes
description: Convert prose into structured, easy-to-review notes.
prompt: Convert the selected text into structured notes with concise headings and bullet points. Preserve important facts, terminology, names, dates, numbers, and relationships. Remove filler and add no outside information.

name: Explain Code
description: Explain what selected code does and how its parts work together.
prompt: Explain the selected code clearly. Describe its purpose, control flow, important data, dependencies, and notable edge cases. Refer to concrete identifiers from the code and distinguish certainty from inference.

name: Find Potential Bugs
description: Inspect selected code for concrete defects and risky edge cases.
prompt: Review the selected code for potential bugs, incorrect assumptions, unhandled edge cases, concurrency problems, resource leaks, and security risks. Prioritize concrete findings, explain why each matters, and suggest a focused fix. Do not invent surrounding code.

name: Refactor Code
description: Improve structure while preserving observable behavior.
prompt: Refactor the selected code to improve structure, maintainability, and clarity while preserving its observable behavior and public interfaces. Avoid unrelated changes. Return the revised code followed by a brief explanation of meaningful changes.

name: Improve Readability
description: Make code easier to understand without broad redesign.
prompt: Improve the readability of the selected code while preserving behavior. Use clearer naming, simpler expressions, consistent formatting, and small local restructuring where useful. Avoid broad architectural changes. Return the revised code.

name: Add Comments
description: Add useful comments for non-obvious intent and constraints.
prompt: Add concise comments to the selected code where intent, constraints, or non-obvious decisions need explanation. Do not narrate obvious syntax or over-comment. Preserve the code exactly apart from comments. Return only the commented code.

name: Explain Error
description: Interpret an error and suggest the most likely next checks.
prompt: Explain the selected error message or stack trace. Identify the likely failing component, translate the message into plain language, list plausible causes in priority order, and suggest focused diagnostic steps. State uncertainty and do not assume missing context.

name: Generate Commit Message
description: Turn a selected diff or change summary into a clear commit message.
prompt: Write a concise Git commit message for the selected diff or change summary. Use an imperative subject no longer than 72 characters. Add a short body only when it clarifies motivation or important behavior. Return only the commit message.

name: Review Code
description: Perform a focused review for correctness and maintainability.
prompt: Review the selected code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and test gaps. Report only actionable findings, ordered by severity, with concrete references and suggested fixes. If no material issue is evident, say so and note remaining uncertainty.

name: Explain Regex
description: Break a regular expression into understandable parts.
prompt: Explain the selected regular expression piece by piece. Describe anchors, groups, classes, quantifiers, flags, captures, and likely matches. Include a few matching and non-matching examples, clearly marked as examples.

name: Explain SQL
description: Explain a query's data flow, joins, filters, and result.
prompt: Explain the selected SQL query in execution-oriented steps. Describe its source tables, joins, filters, grouping, ordering, computed values, and expected result shape. Point out dialect-dependent behavior or potential correctness and performance concerns.

name: Translate
description: Translate selected text into your configured language.
prompt: Translate the selected text into ${language}. Preserve its meaning, tone, formatting, names, numbers, and technical terms. Return only the translation.

name: Translate Naturally
description: Produce idiomatic translation rather than word-for-word phrasing.
prompt: Translate the selected text naturally into ${language}, using idiomatic phrasing appropriate to its audience and tone. Preserve meaning, formatting, names, and technical terms. Avoid literal constructions that sound unnatural. Return only the translation.

name: Translate Literally
description: Stay close to the source wording and structure.
prompt: Translate the selected text into ${language} as literally as possible while remaining grammatical. Preserve wording, sentence structure, formatting, ambiguity, names, and technical terms. Return only the translation.

name: Preserve Formatting While Translating
description: Translate while keeping lists, headings, and line breaks intact.
prompt: Translate the selected text into ${language}. Preserve its structure exactly where practical, including headings, paragraphs, lists, numbering, line breaks, Markdown, placeholders, and code fragments. Translate prose only and return only the translated content.

name: Improve Existing Translation
description: Polish translated text for accuracy and natural flow.
prompt: Improve the selected translated text so it reads naturally and accurately in ${language}. Correct awkward literal phrasing, grammar, and terminology while preserving meaning, facts, tone, names, and formatting. Return only the improved translation.

name: Extract TODOs
description: Turn stated responsibilities and next steps into a task list.
prompt: Extract every explicit task, responsibility, and next step from the selected text. Format them as concise TODO items. Include owners and deadlines only when stated, and do not invent missing details.

name: Convert to Checklist
description: Convert instructions or requirements into checkable items.
prompt: Convert the selected text into a practical Markdown checklist. Keep each item specific and independently checkable, preserve important constraints and ordering, and add no tasks that are not supported by the text.

name: Create Title
description: Generate a concise title that reflects the selected content.
prompt: Create one concise, specific title for the selected text. Reflect its main subject and purpose, match its language and tone, avoid clickbait, and return only the title without quotation marks.

name: Create Bullet Points
description: Reshape prose into concise, logically ordered bullets.
prompt: Convert the selected text into concise bullet points. Preserve all important facts and qualifications, combine closely related ideas, order them logically, and add no outside information. Return only the bullet list.

name: Organize Notes
description: Clean up rough notes into a coherent structure.
prompt: Organize the selected notes into a clear hierarchy with short headings and grouped bullet points. Preserve every meaningful detail, mark uncertainties as written, remove repetition, and add no unsupported information.

name: Turn Into Steps
description: Convert a process into an ordered sequence of actions.
prompt: Convert the selected text into a clear numbered sequence of steps. Preserve prerequisites, dependencies, warnings, and expected outcomes. Make each step actionable and do not invent missing procedures.

name: Brainstorm Next Steps
description: Suggest practical next moves based on the selected context.
prompt: Based on the selected context, propose a concise set of practical next steps. Separate actions clearly supported by the text from optional ideas, prioritize them, and state assumptions instead of presenting them as facts.
